items.question: How many hours per day do employees of the UAE federal government work under the four and a half-day working week?
items.fact: Federal employees work eight hours daily under four and half-day week

items.question: Do employees of the Government of Sharjah work on Fridays under the public sector working week?
items.gold: No, Sharjah government employees work Monday to Thursday, and Friday is part of their three-day weekend.
items.fact: Sharjah government works Monday to Thursday; Friday is weekend
